name: pstack-codex
description: Codex adaptation of Lauren Tan (Poteto)'s Pstack engineering workflows, with native delegation and independent verification.

interface.longDescription: Independent Codex adaptation of Lauren Tan (Poteto)'s MIT-licensed Pstack 0.15.29. Includes 57 skills, 23 task playbooks and engineering principles, including formal-verification workflows. Poteto Mode coordinates useful native subagents with explicit ownership, runtime tool discovery, GPT-6.1 Sol or GPT-6 Astra under the configured reasoning policy and parent verification. Includes setup diagnostics and help. Uses tools exposed by Codex; it does not install MCP servers, models, hooks or background daemons. Original Pstack credit: https://github.com/poteto and https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack.
